# E0205: the version files skip a version

Versions are contiguous: each file is the next minor version of its
predecessor, or the first version of the next major. A gap would be a version
with no file.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
}
```

`ship/history/0.2.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a:  string
	b?: int
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a:  string
	b?: int
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0209]: immutability violation: v0.2 is under history/, and has an error
 --> history/0.2.thema:1:1
  |
1 | Schema: {
  | ^^^^^^
  |
  = note: a version under history/ never changes once it is cut, and had no error when it was cut, so since then its file, another file under history/, or thema has changed
  = help: find which file under history/ changed since it was cut, restore it, and make the change in tip.thema

error[E0205]: history/0.2.thema skips a version: after v0.0 comes v0.1
 --> history/0.2.thema:1:1
  |
1 | Schema: {
  | ^^^^^^
  |
```
